title: Decide whether to delete the local backup-before-rewrite branch
body: Rewriting dev on 2026-11-13 so that prefix-encoder.acre was never committed left the old commits on a local branch, backup-before-rewrite, and in the reflog. Nothing on dev, main or origin holds them. Deleting the branch and expiring the reflog prunes them for good. Jack has not decided yet.
close_reason: Jack chose on 2026-11-24 to delete it. The branch (tip f4067bd) is gone; the reflog still holds the old commits until git expires it, which happens without anyone acting.
